Yet another scary movie has hit theaters. Does Doug get sucked into all the madness? Let's talk about Other Mommy.

Check out our store - https://channelawesome.myshopify.com/

Other Mommy is a 2026 American supernatural psychological horror film directed by Rob Savage and written by Nathan Elston. The film is based on the 2024 novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman. It stars Jessica Chastain as a mother who must do everything to protect her daughter (played by Arabella Olivia Clark) from a supernatural entity that resembles her. Jay Duplass, Dichen Lachman, Arian Moayed, and Karen Allen comprise the supporting cast. James Wan serves as a producer through his Blumhouse–Atomic Monster banner, in association with Spin a Black Yarn.
